Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to disambiguate the film titles before initiating the search. "Heaven Help Us" is a well-known 1985 American film, but "Ghar Ki Rani" is a very common title in Indian cinema with multiple releases (at least one from 1940 and another from 1945). By instructing the WebSurfer to simply search for "Ghar Ki Rani release year" without specifying a decade or distinguishing director, the Planner set up a scenario where conflicting data (1940 vs 1945) would be returned, leading to confusion and an inability to definitively answer which film was released first relative to the specific intended film. The Planner should have either specified a more unique identifier or instructed the agent to explicitly resolve the disambiguation before concluding.
